messages:
maya: Acme Mobile reported frequent SSE mid-stream disconnects when the device switches from corporate WiFi -> personal hotspot. They see an immediate reconnect and sometimes duplicated partial chunks in the transcript. Wants root cause and billing impact.

maya: Symptoms they reported: stream closes with ECONNRESET, client reconnects instantly, new stream receives a repeated chunk (same chunk id) then sometimes a 502. They attached a short raw dump.

maya: Repro steps from customer: 
```
1) Start SSE stream (iOS native SDK)
2) Flip WiFi off -> phone joins hotspot
3) Client reconnects immediately (no backoff)
4) New SSE shows repeated chunk lines like: data: {"id":"c1","delta":"Hello"} twice
```

maya: Trace info: trace=acme-2026-03-10-9f3b, reqs: r_8f3b21 -> r_8f3b22 (close + immediate reopen).

josh: Oncall taking this. Can you paste the server raw stream and the client reconnect timing? Need headers (Authorization, Connection) and whether token was refreshed. Also which SDK primitive (URLSessionStreamTask?).

maya: SDK: internal Swift mobile SDK using URLSessionStreamTask; client calls reconnect immediately from didComplete without any backoff.

maya: Raw server log snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] r_8f3b21 stream start session=acme user=acme-frontend
[2026-03-10T14:02:16Z] r_8f3b21 connection closed: ECONNRESET by peer
[2026-03-10T14:02:16Z] r_8f3b22 new connection start session=acme user=acme-frontend
[2026-03-10T14:02:16Z] r_8f3b22 chunk send: {"id":"c1","delta":"Hello"}
[2026-03-10T14:02:16Z] r_8f3b22 chunk send: {"id":"c1","delta":"Hello"}  <-- duplicate
[2026-03-10T14:02:17Z] r_8f3b22 error: downstream 502 gateway
```

rachel: Duplicate identical chunk IDs implies server resend of the same cached prefix instead of continuing. Could be a race where the old connection is CLOSE_PENDING and a new connection attaches and the prefix flush routine re-emits recent tokens. We need to check per-session sequence HWM (high-water mark) logic.

eng-oncall: I pulled runtime traces for acme-2026-03-10-9f3b. Theres a brief overlap: old worker still in CLOSE_PENDING while new worker marks session ACTIVE. The prefix resend task fires on attach and can emit the last N deltas; if old worker hasn't marked them consumed we end up double-send.

rachel: Action: add defensive check in emitter: if incoming chunk.seq <= session.last_sent_seq then drop and log with reason=duplicate-chunk. I'll open a PR.

josh: Customer also worried about billing for duplicate tokens. Billing: we charge per output token produced by the backend. If server re-emits identical tokens, our billing stack will likely count them unless we dedupe there. Escalating to billing for a potential one-off credit. @billing please standby.

billing: Acknowledged. We'll hold comments until SRE/eng confirm server-side duplication. If confirmed we'll propose a one-time credit for duplicated token usage; need exact token counts.

maya: Mitigations for customer while we investigate: 1) Please add a small reconnect backoff in the mobile SDK (200-500ms exponential) to avoid immediate reattach loops during network handoffs. 2) We'll prepare a tenant-scoped runtime flag to disable prefix re-send for Acme temporarily.

eng-oncall: Forensic repro plan: simulate abrupt TCP RST followed by immediate new SSE with same session token in our harness. Validate duplicate-id path. If reproduced, deploy HWM check to staging and run end-to-end.

rachel: Also instrument logs to emit when duplicate chunk would be sent: include session, chunk.id, chunk.seq, worker id and reason.

josh: I'll coordinate control-plane toggle (tenant-level) and schedule ops to flip if customer wants emergency mitigation.

maya: Customer can reproduce reliably with 3 quick toggles. They will attach iOS network diagnostics and a PCAP. I've asked them to hold any app updates until we confirm safe client-side backoff recommendation. Marking escalated/high priority.

deploy-bot: deploy/bluegreen v1.43 -> canary patch branch created (waiting on tests).

rachel: Next steps summary: 
- eng: HWM defensive check PR + logging (rachel/eng-oncall)
- eng-oncall: run repro harness and validate
- ops: prep tenant toggle for immediate disable of prefix resend for acme
- support/maya: get PCAP and client logs from Acme; recommend small reconnect backoff in mobile SDK
- billing: hold credits pending root cause

rachel: TY — keeping thread open until we confirm root cause and billing resolution.
